name: work-checkpoints
description: Automatically save work checkpoints when sending messages

messageFormat.title: Snapshot message format
messageFormat.description: Used when the shared config.json sets none. Variables: ${branch}, ${date}

dateFormat.title: Date format
dateFormat.description: Used when the shared config.json sets none. Tokens: yyyy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss

ignorePatterns.title: Extra ignore patterns
ignorePatterns.description: Additional ignore patterns, one per line (gitignore syntax). Used when the shared config.json sets none.

retentionDays.title: Keep checkpoints for (days)
retentionDays.description: Used when the shared config.json sets none. 0 disables auto-deletion. Favorites are always kept.
